services.name: River Cruises
services.desc: Looking for a relaxing, family-friendly experience on the water. Showintail Inshore Charters offers dolphin tours, sunset cruises, and snorkeling trips designed for families, couples, and groups who want to enjoy the beauty of the Emerald Coast without fishing. Dolphin tours are one of the most popular activities along the Florida Panhandle and are perfect for all ages. Dolphins are frequently seen, but sightings are always natural and never forced. Enjoy calm conditions, beautiful colors across the sky, and a quiet cruise as the sun sets over the Emerald

includes: Florida fishing licenses for all guests
Fish cleaning and bagging at the dock
blurb: Showintail Inshore Charters offers private fishing charters including inshore, fly fishing, shark fishing, and specialty non-fishing trips like dolphin tours and sunset cruises. Trips are tailored for families, beginners, and experienced anglers, with all gear, licenses, and fish cleaning included. They operate from multiple launch points including Navarre Beach, Pensacola, Gulf Breeze, and Fort Walton Beach.
